decks.title: Numbers, days and months
decks.description: Numbers 0–100, the days of the week and the months, with "on Monday" and "in July".

decks.title: Family and people
decks.description: Family words, describing people, nationalities and jobs.

decks.title: Food and drink
decks.description: Drinks, meals, everyday food and the phrases you need at the table.

decks.title: Home and town
decks.description: Rooms, furniture and places in town, with w or na.

decks.title: Accusative in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the accusative. A1: singular; A2 adds the plural and masculine personal forms.

decks.title: Genitive in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the genitive: after nie, nie ma, do, z (from), od, bez, dla, u, dużo, and for "of". A1: singular; A2 adds the plural after quantity words.

decks.title: Locative in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the locative: after w or na (where?) at A1; A2 adds o (about), po (after), przy, months and the plural.

decks.title: Instrumental in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the instrumental: a job after być, z meaning "with", transport and paying (A1); A2 adds the plural, interesować się and przed, za, nad, pod.

decks.title: Core verbs
decks.description: The most common verbs: type the infinitive, then use it in the present. 100 cards: 60 from A1, 40 from A2. The cards ask for the everyday (imperfective) verb; its partner for a finished action is also accepted.

decks.title: Travel and transport
decks.description: Stations, tickets, planes, luggage and hotels, with the verbs for getting on, off and changing.

decks.title: Shopping and clothes
decks.description: Clothes, colours, sizes and the phrases you need in a clothes shop.

decks.title: Body, health and weather
decks.description: Parts of the body, feeling ill, feelings and the weather.

decks.title: Free time and work
decks.description: Sports, hobbies, playing games and instruments, and everyday words for work.

decks.title: Dative in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the dative: the person who gets something, after pomagać and dziękować, and the "me" in podoba mi się and jest mi zimno.

decks.title: Aspect pairs
decks.description: Type the perfective partner, then choose the right verb of the pair in a sentence. A2 part: 40 of 60 cards; B1 adds the rest.

decks.title: Prepositions and cases
decks.description: Type the preposition and the noun in brackets as one phrase, with the right case: do + sklep → do sklepu. A2 part: 30 of 40 cards; B1 adds "where to" against "where" in full.

decks.title: Numbers with nouns
decks.description: Put the noun in brackets into the form the number needs: 1, 2–4 or 5 and more. A2 part: 20 of 30 cards; B1 adds counting people (dwóch studentów).

decks.title: Verbs of motion
decks.description: Choose between one trip (iść, jechać, lecieć), a habit (chodzić, jeździć, latać) and one finished trip (pójść, pojechać, polecieć). A2 part: 25 of 40 cards; B1 and B2 add the prefixed verbs.
